product_launches.description: PayFit expanded its HR and payroll offering into an end-to-end managed service augmented by its contextual AI assistant, PayFit AI, which now operates directly in payroll processes to detect inconsistencies, generate reports, handle employee queries and enter payroll variables, with further action-taking capabilities on contracts and leave coming later this year.
PayFit launched its AI assistant feature PayFit Copilot in 2024 to help HR teams handle complex payroll and people queries more efficiently.

about_short_description.short_description: PayFit offers technology that simplifies and automates payroll and HR processes for small and medium-sized businesses.

product.name: UK Payroll Software
product.description: Cloud-based software that automates payroll processing, including earnings, deductions, and HMRC RTI submissions for UK small and medium businesses.

product.name: Leave and Absence Management
product.description: A module to manage employee leave and absences, allowing easy tracking and approval of time off that integrates with payroll.

product.name: Expense Management
product.description: A system to manage employee expenses by creating policies, allowing receipt uploads, and integrating expense data with payroll in real time.

product.name: Pension Management
product.description: Automated pension submissions for major UK pension providers integrated with payroll processing to ensure compliance and accuracy.

product.name: Performance and People Management
product.description: A tool for tracking employee performance and managing development through intuitive performance reviews and goal tracking.

product.name: Employee Self-Service Portal
product.description: A portal that allows employees to access payslips, request leave, upload expenses, and manage personal data independently.
